summary: CN Energy Group filed a Form 6-K reporting a Nasdaq minimum bid price deficiency notice. The company has a 180-day compliance period until January 12, 2027, to regain compliance by maintaining a closing bid price of $1.00 for ten consecutive business days. It may seek an additional 180-day grace period if it meets other initial listing standards and notifies Nasdaq of its intent to cure, potentially through a reverse stock split. Failure could lead to delisting with appeal rights. This is a routine continued listing notification, not a delisting event; no special situation category applies.
